source_spans.narration_exact: Inventory reports opens Choose a report with Inventory on hand displayed. Continue leads toward Narrow it down, but this view is the chooser, not a generated report or exported PDF. Fire and EMS administrators, like other services, should verify a report’s scope before relying on its numbers. Keep catalogue setup, recorded movements, stock counts and reporting distinct so that another person can understand what each result actually establishes. The same process supports fire and EMS, community paramedicine and mental health response, search and rescue, security departments and companies, wildland contractors, and industrial emergency response teams.
